name.zh: 上海艾克森股份有限公司

short_description.en: Provider of low-carbon data center and heat exchange solutions, specializing in plate heat exchangers, fully welded exchangers, and integrated thermal systems.
short_description.zh: 专注于低碳数据中心与换热解决方案，提供板式换热器、全焊式换热器及系统集成热管理设备的换热解决方案提供商。

en: Shanghai Accessen Co., Ltd. is a heat exchange solution provider specializing in the R&D, manufacturing, sales, and service of heat exchange equipment. The company focuses on low-carbon data center solutions and broader thermal management applications across heating, refrigeration, and industrial sectors.

Its manufacturing base spans more than 100,000 square meters across the Xiechun Road factory in Shanghai and the Taicang Port Area factory. Accessen supports customers through a direct sales and service network covering major cities in China as well as overseas markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.

Accessen serves data center, HVAC, refrigeration, energy and power, steel and metallurgy, petrochemical, food and pharmaceutical, new energy electronics, marine and offshore, and environmental treatment applications. The company positions plate heat exchange and system integration as its two core technologies.

Its AS-standard product portfolio includes plate heat exchangers and units, fully welded plate-shell and plate-frame heat exchangers, fully welded air heat exchangers, process water cooling systems, waste heat recovery systems, and prefabricated integrated cooling stations. The company states compliance with international standards and certifications including ASME, CE, AHRI, API, DNV, GL, LR, ABS, BV, NK, KR, CCS, RINA, RS, CCC, and GB.
zh: 上海艾克森股份有限公司是专业从事换热设备研发、制造、销售及服务的换热解决方案提供商，重点面向低碳数据中心以及供热、制冷和工业等热管理场景提供产品与服务。
公司生产总部位于中国上海黄渡工业园，拥有谢春路工厂和太仓港区工厂，制造基地总面积超过 100000 平方米。艾克森建立了覆盖全国主要省市并延伸至香港、新加坡、马来西亚、泰国等市场的销售与服务网络。
公司服务领域涵盖数据中心、暖通空调、制冷冷却、能源电力、钢铁冶金、石油化工、食品医药、新能源电子、船舶海工及环保处理等细分市场，并以板式换热和系统集成为两大核心技术。
其 AS 标准产品体系覆盖板式换热器、板式换热机组、全焊板壳式换热器、全焊板框式换热器、全焊空气换热器、工艺水冷却系统、余热回收系统和预装式集成冷站等，并宣称产品符合 ASME、CE、AHRI、API、DNV、GL、LR、ABS、BV、NK、KR、CCS、RINA、RS、CCC、GB 等国际规范和标准。

en: Large-Scale Manufacturing Base: Accessen operates more than 100,000 square meters of manufacturing space across its Shanghai and Taicang facilities.
Dual Core Competence: The company emphasizes plate heat exchange technology and system integration as its core technical capabilities.
Broad Product Portfolio: Products cover plate heat exchangers, fully welded exchangers, process cooling systems, waste heat recovery systems, and prefabricated integrated cooling stations.
International Standards and Certifications: The company highlights compliance with ASME, CE, AHRI, API, DNV, GL, LR, ABS, BV, NK, KR, CCS, RINA, RS, CCC, and GB standards and certifications.
Extensive Service Coverage: Direct sales and service support covers major Chinese markets and selected overseas markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
Proven Deployment Scale: Accessen states it has delivered solutions across more than 20,000 implementation cases and supports customers through a large service network.
zh: 规模化制造基础：公司在上海和太仓拥有超过 100000 平方米的制造基地。
核心技术明确：以板式换热和系统集成为两大核心技术，支撑多场景热管理解决方案。
产品体系完整：覆盖板式换热器、全焊式换热器、工艺冷却系统、余热回收系统和预装式集成冷站等产品。
国际规范与认证覆盖广：官网明确列出 ASME、CE、AHRI、API、DNV、GL、LR、ABS、BV、NK、KR、CCS、RINA、RS、CCC、GB 等标准和认证。
服务网络覆盖广：拥有覆盖国内主要省市并延伸至部分海外市场的直属销售与服务网络。
项目应用基础扎实：官网披露已有 20000 多个应用案例，并通过较大的服务网络支持项目交付与售后。

name.en: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
name.zh: 四平维克斯换热设备有限公司

short_description.en: Professional manufacturer of heat exchange equipment and pressure vessel products, covering plate, tubular, spiral, air-side, and integrated heat exchange solutions.
short_description.zh: 专业从事换热设备及压力容器产品制造，产品覆盖板式、管壳式、螺旋板式、空气类换热器及换热机组。

en: Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of heat exchange equipment. According to the official company profile, its predecessor was Siping Heat Exchanger General Factory, founded in 1963, and it served as a designated heat exchange equipment production plant under the Ministry of Machinery while producing various heat exchange equipment and pressure vessel products.

In 1993, the company cooperated with France's VICARB and introduced a complete set of internationally advanced heat exchanger products, manufacturing technology, proprietary know-how, and processing equipment. It then began batch production of V series plate heat exchangers and heat exchanger units.

In 2002, the company was restructured as Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd. and continued manufacturing imported plate heat exchangers and heat exchange units while also developing multiple products with independent intellectual property. The English homepage describes the company as a core member of ViEX Group with global design, manufacturing, development, research, sales, and service resources.

The official profile states that the garden-style factory covers 60,000 square meters, with 26,000 square meters of building area, 15,000 square meters of workshop area, and 310 sets of professional equipment. The company lists annual capacity of 200,000 square meters of plate heat exchangers, 3,000 tons of pressure vessels, shell-and-tube and air heat exchangers, and 500 sets of integrated heat exchange equipment, and it also highlights honors including high-tech enterprise recognition and the Jilin Provincial Quality Award.
zh: 四平维克斯换热设备有限公司是经营换热设备的专业制造公司。官网介绍其前身为始建于1963年的四平换热器总厂，是机械部换热设备定点生产厂，长期专业生产各种热交换设备及压力容器产品。
1993年，公司与法国维卡勃公司合资合作，全套引进具有国际水平的热交换器产品、制造技术、专有技术和工艺加工装备，开始批量制造V系列板式换热器、换热机组等产品。
2002年，企业改制为四平维克斯换热设备有限公司，继续生产制造引进的板式换热器及换热机组，同时开发了多种具有自主知识产权的民族品牌产品。英文官网还将其描述为ViEX Group核心成员，具备覆盖设计、制造、研发、销售与服务的全球化体系。
官网资料显示，公司园林式工厂占地面积6万平方米，建筑面积2.6万平方米，厂房面积1.5万平方米，拥有专业设备310台套，年生产能力包括板式换热器20万平方米、压力容器及管壳式和空气类换热器3000吨、集成式换热成套设备500套，并获得国家高新技术企业、吉林省质量奖等荣誉。

en: Long manufacturing history rooted in Siping Heat Exchanger General Factory established in 1963.
Introduced international plate heat exchanger technology and equipment through cooperation with France's VICARB.
Broad product portfolio spanning plate, tubular, spiral plate, air-side heat exchangers, integrated units, and pressure vessels.
Scaled manufacturing base with 60,000 square meters of site area and 310 sets of professional equipment.
Large stated production capacity for plate heat exchangers, pressure vessels, air heat exchangers, and integrated heat exchange equipment.
Officially highlighted as a high-tech enterprise and recipient of the Jilin Provincial Quality Award.
zh: 源自1963年创建的四平换热器总厂，具备较长的换热设备制造历史。
通过与法国维卡勃合作，引进了国际水平的板式换热器产品、技术和工艺装备。
产品覆盖板式、管壳式、螺旋板式、空气类换热器、换热机组及压力容器，产品线较完整。
官网披露工厂占地6万平方米，拥有310台套专业设备，制造基础较完善。
具备板式换热器、压力容器和成套换热设备的规模化年产能力。
官网展示其获得国家高新技术企业、吉林省质量奖等荣誉。

name.en: Siping Juyuan Welded Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
name.zh: 四平巨元焊接板式换热器有限公司

short_description.en: Manufacturer of welded plate heat exchangers and customized heat transfer solutions for power, petrochemical, marine, HVAC, food, and other industrial applications.
short_description.zh: 面向电力、石油化工、船舶、暖通、食品等工业场景提供焊接板式换热器及定制化传热解决方案的制造商。

en: Siping Juyuan Welded Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd. traces its roots to the Welded Plate Division established by Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Equipment Co., Ltd. in 1998. Since its inception, the team has focused on the research and development of fully welded plate heat exchanger technology, process, and structure.

The company offers a broad range of fully welded heat exchange products with new technologies, processes, and structures. According to the official company profile, these products are used to provide individualized and specialized solutions for military, nuclear, biomass, power, petroleum, chemical, metallurgical, shipbuilding, central heating, air conditioning and refrigeration, food and beverage, seawater desalination, and distributed energy applications.

The company states that it relies on customer resources together with big data and Internet of Things concepts to build a product operation parameter database and a product life cycle service system, while continuing to improve its products, innovation capability, and service quality.
zh: 四平巨元焊接板式换热器有限公司前身为四平市巨元瀚洋板式换热设备有限公司于1998年成立的焊接板事业部，长期从事全焊接板式换热器技术、工艺、结构的研发与科技创新工作。
公司以全新技术、工艺、结构的全焊接换热产品为载体，为军工、核能、生物质能、电力、石油、化工、冶金、船舶、集中供热、空调制冷、食品饮料、海水淡化、分布式能源等行业提供个性化、专业化解决方案。
官网介绍显示，公司依托客户资源，以大数据和物联网理念建立产品运行参数数据库和产品全生命周期服务系统，并持续改进、创新、学习和提高，为客户提供更专业的产品与更完善的服务。

en: Long-term specialization in welded plate heat exchanger technology dating back to the original welded plate division established in 1998.
Broad welded product portfolio covering multiple structures such as plate-frame, wide-channel, and specialized cooling applications.
Application coverage across power, petrochemical, marine, HVAC, food and beverage, and other industrial sectors mentioned on the official website.
Official company profile highlights ongoing research, process innovation, and structural innovation for fully welded heat exchange products.
The company states that it uses product operation data and lifecycle service concepts to support more tailored industrial solutions.
zh: 焊接板技术积累深厚，源自1998年成立的焊接板事业部，长期专注于全焊接板式换热器研发。
产品结构覆盖较广，包含板框式、宽通道式及专用冷却器等多类焊接换热产品。
官网明确覆盖电力、石油化工、船舶、暖通、食品饮料等多个工业应用领域。
强调围绕全焊接换热产品持续进行技术、工艺和结构创新。
依托产品运行参数数据库和全生命周期服务系统，面向客户提供更有针对性的解决方案。

name.en: Lanzhou Lanshi Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.
name.zh: 兰州兰石换热设备有限责任公司

short_description.en: Manufacturer of plate heat exchangers, welded heat exchangers, PCHE systems, and heat exchange units for energy, petrochemical, HVAC, marine, pharmaceutical, and food industries.
short_description.zh: 面向能源、石油化工、暖通、船舶、制药、食品等行业提供板式换热器、焊接式换热器、PCHE 及换热机组的制造商。

en: Lanzhou Lanshi Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd. was established in 2002 through the restructuring of the former plate heat exchanger plant of Lanzhou Petrochemical Machinery General Plant. It is a subsidiary of the listed company Lanshi Heavy Equipment and focuses on the research, design, manufacturing, and engineering service of plate heat exchangers.

The company is one of the drafting units for GB16409-1996 Plate Heat Exchanger, GB/T28185-2011 Heat Exchange Unit for Urban Heating, and the Ministry of Construction industry standard CJ/T191-2004 Plate Heat Exchange Unit. Its products are used in energy saving and environmental protection, nuclear power, aerospace, petrochemical, HVAC, marine, metallurgy, bio-energy, power generation, pharmaceuticals, textile, paper, and food sectors.

Tracing its technical heritage to 1965, when China’s first plate heat exchanger was developed, the company has built more than 100 heat exchanger series and achieved multiple domestic industry firsts. After moving to Lanzhou New Area in 2014, its production area expanded to more than 530,000 square meters with nearly 200 additional equipment sets. The company also reports exports to Russia, Finland, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Mongolia, and Vietnam.

The company states that it has obtained ISO 14001 environmental management certification, occupational health and safety system certification, ASME-related qualifications, pressure vessel qualifications, nuclear quality assurance qualifications, and product safety registration management credentials. It also states that it can design and manufacture in accordance with Chinese national and industry standards as well as ASME and European PED standards.
zh: 兰州兰石换热设备有限责任公司成立于2002年，由原兰州石油化工机器总厂板式换热器厂改制而来，是上市公司兰石重装公司下属的专业从事板式热交换器研发、设计、生产和工程服务的子公司。
公司也是 GB16409-1996《板式换热器》、GB/T28185-2011《城镇供热用换热机组》以及建设部行业标准 CJ/T191-2004《板式换热机组》的起草单位之一。产品主要应用于节能环保、核电、航空航天、石油化工、暖通空调、船舶、冶金、生物能源、电力、制药、纺织、造纸、食品等领域。
公司技术渊源可追溯到 1965 年中国第一台板式热交换器的研制。根据官网介绍，公司先后研发成功了 100 多种系列热交换器产品，取得多项国内和行业首创成果；2014 年整体搬迁至兰州新区后，生产作业面积扩大到 53 万余平方米，新增设备近 200 台套。官网同时提到公司产品出口至俄罗斯、芬兰、斯里兰卡、巴基斯坦、蒙古、越南等国家和地区。
公司官网表示，其已取得 ISO14001 环境管理体系、职业健康安全体系、ASME、压力容器、核质保体系、安全注册管理体系等相关资质，并可按照国家及行业标准、美国 ASME 及欧洲 PED 等标准进行设计和制造。

en: Dedicated plate heat exchanger specialist under Lanshi Heavy Equipment with in-house R&D, design, manufacturing, and engineering service capability.
One of the drafting units for major Chinese standards covering plate heat exchangers and urban heating heat exchange units.
Technical heritage linked to China’s first plate heat exchanger development and a product portfolio of more than 100 heat exchanger series.
Large manufacturing base in Lanzhou New Area with more than 530,000 square meters of production area and nearly 200 additional equipment sets after relocation.
Broad industry coverage across petrochemical, HVAC, marine, bio-energy, pharmaceuticals, food, and power-related applications.
Verified company qualifications shown on the official site include nuclear safety licenses, product safety registration, management system certificates, and special equipment production license.
zh: 依托兰石重装平台，具备板式换热器研发、设计、制造与工程服务的一体化能力。
是板式换热器及城镇供热换热机组等多项国家和行业标准的起草单位之一。
技术积累可追溯至中国第一台板式热交换器的研制，已形成 100 多种系列热交换器产品。
兰州新区制造基地生产作业面积超过 53 万平方米，搬迁后新增近 200 台套设备。
产品覆盖石油化工、暖通、船舶、生物能源、制药、食品、电力等多个行业应用。
官网展示了民用核安全许可证、板式热交换器产品安全注册证、管理体系证书及特种设备生产许可证等资质。

name.en: Shanghai Heat Transfer Equipment Co., Ltd.
name.zh: 上海板换机械设备有限公司

short_description.en: Manufacturer of plate heat exchangers and custom heat transfer systems for oil and gas, chemical, power, marine, HVAC, and other industrial sectors.
short_description.zh: 面向石油天然气、化工、电力、船舶、暖通等工业领域的板式热交换器及定制传热系统制造商。

en: Shanghai Heat Transfer Equipment Co., Ltd. (SHPHE) is a technology-driven manufacturer and solution provider specializing in the design, manufacturing, installation, and service of plate heat exchangers and complete heat transfer systems. The company serves customers across oil and gas, marine, HVAC, chemical, food and pharmaceutical, power, bioenergy, metallurgy, machinery, pulp and paper, and steel industries.

SHPHE’s main products include plate and frame heat exchangers, wide-gap welded plate heat exchangers, HT-Bloc welded plate heat exchangers, TP welded plate heat exchangers, and plate air preheaters. With advanced engineering, manufacturing, welding, and testing capabilities, the company provides customized heat transfer solutions for complex industrial operating conditions.

Driven by continuous innovation, SHPHE has developed multiple high-pressure and large-scale heat exchanger products, including large plate heat exchangers for FPSO applications, 5 MPa high-pressure plate heat exchangers, 9.6 MPa internal plate heaters for strippers, and large HT-Bloc welded plate heat exchangers rated for 6.4 MPa and 410°C.

The company holds multiple certifications, including quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management system certifications, special equipment production license for pressure vessels, plate heat exchanger safety and energy-saving registrations, and international certificates such as ASME, CCS, CE, BV, ABS, GL, and NK. SHPHE has also participated in drafting national and industry standards, and has supplied equipment and services to major domestic and international customers including CNPC, Sinopec, CNOOC, BASF, LANXESS, BP, POSCO, Rio Tinto, Petronas, and others.
zh: 上海板换机械设备有限公司（SHPHE）是一家技术型制造企业及解决方案提供商，专业从事板式热交换器及成套传热系统的设计、制造、安装和服务。公司长期服务于石油天然气、船舶、暖通空调、化工、食品医药、电力、生物能源、冶金、机械制造、造纸、钢铁等行业客户。
公司主要产品包括可拆卸板式热交换器、宽通道全焊接板式热交换器、板框式热交换器、TP混合板式热交换器、板式空气预热器等。依托先进的工程设计、制造、焊接和测试能力，公司能够为复杂工业工况提供定制化传热解决方案。
依托持续的自主创新，公司在高压、大型化及复杂工况换热设备方面不断突破，先后开发了海上浮式生产储油装置用大型板式热交换器、5MPa高压板式热交换器、9.6MPa汽提塔内置板式加热器，以及耐压6.4MPa、耐温410℃的大型HT-Bloc全焊接板式热交换器等产品。
公司拥有质量、环境、职业健康安全管理体系认证，特种设备生产许可（压力容器），板式热交换器产品安全注册和节能注册，以及ASME、CCS、CE、BV、ABS、GL、NK等多项证书。同时，公司参与了多项国家和行业标准起草，并已为中石油、中石化、中海油、BASF、LANXESS、BP、POSCO、Rio Tinto、Petronas等众多国内外工业客户提供换热设备和相关服务。

en: Specialized Heat Exchanger Expertise: Focused on plate heat exchangers and complete heat transfer systems, with deep technical knowledge across demanding industrial applications.
Advanced Engineering and Manufacturing: Strong design, production, welding, and testing capabilities support customized solutions for complex operating conditions.
High-Pressure and Large-Scale Capability: Proven development experience in high-pressure and large-size heat exchangers, including 5 MPa, 6.4 MPa, and 9.6 MPa applications.

Certified Quality and Compliance: Holds management system certifications, pressure vessel production license, plate heat exchanger safety and energy-saving registrations, and international certificates including ASME, CCS, CE, BV, ABS, GL, and NK.

Standards Drafting Experience: Participated in drafting national and industry standards for heat exchanger energy efficiency testing, plate and frame heat exchangers, welded plate heat exchangers, and procurement specifications.
Global Service Network: Based in Shanghai with global sales and service coverage, supporting customers across Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Oceania.

Trusted by Major Industrial Customers: Supplied equipment and services to leading domestic and multinational companies across oil and gas, chemical, marine, metallurgy, power, HVAC, and other sectors.
